sentences.text: Shri Jagdish Baheti and Shri Prabuddha Singh - advoca  petitioner/accused is present.
Ms. Megha Jain - Public Prosecutor for the respondent present.
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner/accused under Section 528 of BNNS for seeking quashment of FIR case in Crime No.90/2021 dated 13/03/2021 under Section 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

Learned Public Prosecutor stated that after investigation, investigating agency filed the charge-sheet and took the cognizance as RCT No.7390/2024 and charges have yet to be framed by the trial Court.
Issue notice to the second respondent, directed the police to serve the notice on respondent No.2 and file a proof of service through Public Prosecutor.
In view of the findings of Supreme Court in SLP (Criminal) No.54673/2024 dated 09/12/2024 and in SLP (Criminal) NO.17611/2024 dated 20/01/2025, interim stay cannot be granted.
Directed the petitioner to co-operate with the trial.
